title: Four Kids, Four Colors: A Full App Redesign | vitalii.no
description:
Four kids, one app — and until this redesign, it looked exactly the same for every one of them. The whole interface used one flat green theme and identical grey circle avatars, so nothing visually set the kids apart, and the app read more like an admin tool than something a kid wanted to open to call a cousin.

I rebuilt the visual layer end to end without touching any backend logic. New design tokens replace the flat green with one vivid blue for actions plus four accent colors — sun, coral, mint and grape — each one assigned from a person's own id, so the same kid shows the same color in Chats, People and Conversation every time. Avatars became squircles, a floating tab bar replaced the old navigation, calls and media moved to bottom sheets, and the Android launcher icon and theme were redrawn to match.

Four kids now have four stable, personal colors instead of one shared grey default, and every screen — web app and Android launcher alike — shares the same identity for the first time. Before/after screenshots are saved to catch any screen that slips back toward the old green.
